text:
maria: Quick heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/19877 is ready, just waiting on CI. Trying to land before tomorrow's deploy freeze. Anyone available for quick eyes? :eyes:
ci-bot: CI status: 8/10 checks passed, flaky e2e failing on mac-3, rerun queued.
jake: @maria I can re-run flaky job now. Any remaining review comments?
maria: just one small nit from @lina about a log line. pushing fix in a minute.
lina: small nit only, lgtm after rebase. also heads-up: rebase window is open 01:00-03:00 UTC tonight.
ashwin: If we miss that window we should avoid landing until post-freeze. Can someone take the rebase? I'm oncall till 00:30 UTC.
jake: I'll take the rebase and trigger a full CI after fix. ETA ~15m.
release-bot: Scheduled maintenance (deploy freeze) starts at 03:00 UTC. Any merges after 02:30 risk partial rollout hold.
maria: thanks @jake — pushed the fix and rebased onto main. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/19877/files
ci-bot: Rerun started for PR 19877. Current queue position: 4. Estimated finish: ~12min.
lina: reviewing now. quick approve if tests green.
jake: CI green on all nodes except intermittent mac-3; retrying that job only.
ci-bot: mac-3 job retried and passed. All checks green ✅
lina: LGTM. @maria you have approval from me.
ashwin: I'm dropping an approval too — go for merge once release-bot confirms no blackout. :thumbsup:
release-bot: No blackout — deploy freeze starts at 03:00 UTC, current time 01:58 UTC. Merge allowed but expect canary delay.
maria: merging now. thanks all! :tada:
jake: merged and green on main. monitoring logs for 10m canary.
maria: noted, will watch metrics. if anything spikes I'll revert quickly.
ashwin: great job — quick and tidy. CI queue tetris = solved. :party-parrot:
